answer_1.quote: We focus specifically on introducing an inductive bias that is helpful for tasks that traditionally have been approached with Finite State Transducers (FSTs)... Our approach (SIP, for Simulation-Induced Prior) is simple (see Fig. ): given a representation of an FST and an input string, a Transformer is pre-trained to predict what the output of the FST is on the given input.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates output strings such as phoneme transcriptions (e.g., [Ekspl@"neIS@n] for 'explanation') and edited text (e.g., J. Doe from Jane Doe).
